performed_via_github_app.description:
Publish incredibly high performance websites and applications right from GitHub. The Netlify platform connects your repositories to an all-in-one workflow for global CDN deployment, continuous integration, and automatic (and free) HTTPS. Each time you commit changes, Netlify builds your site, prerenders markup, and optimizes assets on dedicated build infrastructure. Easily create an entirely automated workflows for your web applications

## Features

### Push your site live, directly from GitHub
Deploy your site to an ultra-redundant global CDN that’s purpose built for serving pages and assets quickly and consistently.

### Automate deployment
Netlify’s built-in Continuous Deployment automatically runs your build commands and deploys the result whenever you push to your Git repository.

### Add a custom domain
Purchase domains and manage DNS zones and records right inside of Netlify.

### HTTPS is automatic
Your site will automatically be secured with a free TLS certificate from Let’s Encrypt.

### Deploy Previews
Netlify’s Deploy Previews streamlined your workflow by giving you a unique, permanent URL to check what your changes will be like in production whenever you submit a pull request.

### And a lot more!
Netlify includes solutions for forms, identity, and even custom functions powered by AWS Lambda. And all this functionality can be configured directly in your repo.

@aarongarciah 

- I think focus rings should be black (or whatever very high-contrast gray we use)
- Accordion will prob look better if the border encloses the whole Root, so border on left + right sides too. Then we can add padding-inline and a hover state to the buttons.
- What are the icon styles for? Icons shouldn't have any styles besides `display: block`?
- Why not use `line-height: 1` on buttons?
- Add `gap` to buttons that contain text?
- The `padding-block` in Autocomplete + Combobox popup needs to be half its current size.
- Popup/widget group labels should have the exact same styles as items, but just low-contrast text color. Same weight, height, letter-spacing, text-transform etc.
- Sticky group labels seem unnecessarily opinionated to me?
- Dialog padding should be 16px computed.
- Dialog title should be 16px computed.
- Dialog title needs 4px space beneath it.
- The `margin-top` on DialogActions is weird. `gap` is better.
- Why does Drawer have a cropped black border that's only visible on the top edge? In the nested drawers example, when you open the nested drawer, one drawer just has a black border along the top edge?
- Drawer shadows extend upwards, when the drawer opens from the bottom? That's not how shadows work, they come from a light source, which is always in the same place. x + y values should be the same everywhere.
- Numberfield input padding should be 8px computed.
- Numberfield input `outline-offset` should be `-1px`.
- Popover title needs 4px space beneath it.
- Popover trigger should be a text label button, not an icon button.
- Text inside preview card should not be low-contrast.
- Scrollbar is enormous, needs to be way thinner.
- What is the `::before` for in ScrollArea styles?
- Tab panels should contain text, not icons.
- Toast titles need 4px space beneath them
@aarongarciah Remove the :active style from Accordion buttons. It's too noisy.

1. The outline being inset 1px when focused feels odd to me and makes it look quite cramped 2. The icons in the Combobox input look oddly aligned? 3. The height of the Combobox popup doesn't align with the scroll-margin anymore so it shifts once it reaches the scroll boundary 4. The checkbox/radio buttons feel slightly too small?

1. The number not being centered here feels off: --- 2. Focus outline looks cramped here: --- 3. Popup should cover right edge of trigger: --- 4. Focus state glitch: --- 5. This Navigation Menu demo doesn't seem to transition the content on the x-axis or its opacity? --- 6. Selection highlight should be gray or even transparent?

Scale animation is broken for this -- no transition. `opacity` works though. Is it intentional the text isn't centered? Should the switch's background-color transition? It looks slightly odd that the thumb transitions but not the background-color. This should have a black focus ring: The bottom padding of combobox lists seems to be smaller than the top padding: The year text feels slightly hard to read: The Grid layout example looks off center: There's too much space beneath the emoji list?: This example looks too small?: Mismatched padding-y here: The Dialog demos' transition duration seems too slow compared to the hero demo. The Outside Scroll Dialog's translateY animation seems much too fast?
Not sure how I feel about pure white borders in dark mode. Kind of feels too harsh. Maybe a light gray would work better?

@atomiks 

> 1. The outline being inset 1px when focused feels odd to me and makes it look quite cramped

All focus rings have been updated.

> 2. The icons in the Combobox input look oddly aligned?

We have new icons now.

> 3. The height of the Combobox popup doesn't align with the scroll-margin anymore so it shifts once it reaches the scroll boundary

I think this is fixed now.

> 4. The checkbox/radio buttons feel slightly too small?

You mean the checkmark icon? We have a new one now.

---

> 1. The number not being centered here feels off:

We decided to leave it left-aligned.

> 2. Focus outline looks cramped here:

Fixed

> 3.  Popup should cover right edge of trigger:

Fixed

> 4. Focus state glitch:

Fixed (the outline could be improved then is pressed but that's another issue)

> 5. This Navigation Menu demo doesn't seem to transition the content on the x-axis or its opacity?

I _think_ I fixed the regression

> 6. Selection highlight should be gray or even transparent?

That change was part of another PR. I rebased and now it's gray.

---

> 1. 🔴 CSS Modules exports no longer include the demo color theme (blocking)

The issue reported by Codex is not really an issue. Before merging, we'll replace all CSS vars in CSS modules demos to use raw values.

@atomiks 

> Scale animation is broken for this -- no transition. opacity works though.

Fixed

> Is it intentional the text isn't centered?  Yes  > Should the switch's background-color transition? It looks slightly odd that the thumb transitions but not the background-color.

Updated. I wasn’t sure about it.

> This should have a black focus ring:

Updated all focus rings to be "black" on the docs shell.

> The bottom padding of combobox lists seems to be smaller than the top padding:

I added `overflow: clip` to the `.Popup` part to avoid the scrollbar overflowing it, but then it made the bottom padding smaller. Turns out I didn’t realize it was a miscalculation on the max-height 😅. Should be fixed now on all popups.
￼
> The year text feels slightly hard to read:

Tweaked. There might be some more cases like this in dark mode. There will be plenty more PRs to tweak stuff.

> The Grid layout example looks off center:

Fixed

> There's too much space beneath the emoji list?:

Fixed

> This example looks too small?:

Why is that? It’s a 32x32 avatar, same size as buttons, inputs, etc.

> The Dialog demos' transition duration seems too slow compared to the hero demo.

Fixed

> The Outside Scroll Dialog's translateY animation seems much too fast?

Fixed

> Not sure how I feel about pure white borders in dark mode. Kind of feels too harsh. Maybe a light gray would work better?

We might change it in another PR to gray-50. Leaving as is in this PR.

> Why is that? It’s a 32x32 avatar, same size as buttons, inputs, etc.

For a demo, it just looks too small, even if the size is realistic in actual apps. Just my opinion though.

>  Updated. I wasn’t sure about it.

Thumb still needs it too:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/36259c80-c3a5-4815-bf50-29995edba175
8px width scrollbar thumbs aren't accessible without an extended hit area to be 16-18px (Windows/macOS defaults). The original demo had a hit area iirc. This includes the Dialog demos.

> Thumb still needs it too: There was a bug on TW demos with separate `transition-transform` and `transition-colors` instead of a single `transition-[translate,background-color]`. > 8px width scrollbar thumbs aren't accessible without an extended hit area to be 16-18px (Windows/macOS defaults). The original demo had a hit area iirc. Good point. Re-added on all demos using ScrollArea. What do you think about expanding the hit area outside of the scrolling container? In some scenarios is not useful (e.g. when the ScrollAre touches the viewport edge) and in others could be harmful (e.g. if the scrolling container's edge is touching some interactive element). So I was thinking on expanding the hit area only inwards. This wasn't a problem before this PR because the visible ScrollArea was inset.

> What do you think about expanding the hit area outside of the scrolling container?

No. Delete. Put it back to a simple 15px/16px scrollbar and delete the pseudo element like I said before.

> Put it back to a simple 15px/16px scrollbar and delete the pseudo element like I said before.

The thick scrollbar looked pretty terrible to me. The extended hit area is a more realistic use case with a thin track/thumb which is the case in ~every app.

It looks awful yeah. But it's more important that initial demos are simple. The plan is to move fancy hit target tricks, and animation demos, to future examples. Just trying to keep this PR simple so we can merge it asap.
Updated the scrollbars to be thiiiick again (I love them)

The Tailwind version of the Accordion demo (and maybe Collapsible) has weird jumpy easing. I don't notice it with CSS Modules.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/3200634d-2ab6-47e3-a4fe-d8a3ca522e98
Nested Dialogs + Close confirmation TW examples are mispositioned
`padding-y` of both CSS Modules and is still off in this example. The bottom has slightly more padding
Found a blue ring:
Shouldn't the link be black now?
I think these classes should go beneath the component definition. Comps like NavigationMenu do this.

The highlight should probably be darker here, as it's not close to being accessible and on LQ screens probably is not differentiable at all. There's an open issue about this, but I think the 3:1 contrast requirement stated is excessive. I think it should match gray text selection color or a bit lighter I also don't think the scrollbars should fade out when hovering out. It's quite distracting
The focus outline here seems weird?

> `padding-y` of both CSS Modules and is still off in this example. The bottom has slightly more padding

That's caused by the focus ring being offset 1px.

> The Tailwind version of the Accordion demo (and maybe Collapsible) has weird jumpy easing. I don't notice it with CSS Modules. Updated the easing on the Tailwind demo to match the CSS modules one. > Found a blue ring Updated. > Shouldn't the link be black now? Good point. Updated. > Nested Dialogs + Close confirmation TW examples are mispositioned Fixed. > I think these classes should go beneath the component definition. Comps like NavigationMenu do this. Not really related to this PR, but updated all demos that I saw following this pattern. > The highlight should probably be darker here, Updated to use neutral-200 / neutral-700 (light mode / dark mode) for the highlighted bg. > I also don't think the scrollbars should fade out when hovering out. It's quite distracting. You mean it should always be visible or only when scrolling? > The focus outline here seems weird? Do you prefer this?

> Do you prefer this?

I think what's on the live site is fine? (no focus ring)

> Small nitpick on the positioning of the context menu.

Yeah, it matches macOS

> You mean it should always be visible or only when scrolling?

Always visible, same as the docs shell one
Empty state looks off here - should be centered? Padding is off in this one:
Spacing seems off:

- Accordion triggers are too wide to fit on iPhone (base)
- Navigation Menu on iPhone causes text reflow as it transitions the width (`Styling` menu for example)
- Object values Select demo is missing highlight for touch despite being a single selection mode
- This isn't new, but `overscroll-behavior: contain` should be added to the Select scrollable lists for mobile
- Long pressing Context Menu on iPhone causes a selection bubble to appear (not on live site)
- Opening Select inside the Toolbar demo on touch reveals a broken trigger state 
- The search box when it has no focus state [default for mobile] for autocomplete and combobox when the trigger is inside the popup looks off as there's no separation

@atomiks @flaviendelangle @michaldudak I'll apply some more improvements over the few next hours, but we want to merge this before the release. Many demos need improvements, but I think it'd be better to merge and iterate if we can't include every possible improvement in this PR.

One important thing I'd love to have feedback on: what do you think about the removal of `theme.css` from CSS Modules demos? The idea is to have as few abstractions as possible. As you probably noticed, we no longer have a custom set of CSS vars: we use default Tailwind CSS vars. That means, we now rely on `dark:` class names for Tailwind demos, and we rely on `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)` for CSS Modules demos. In CSS Modules demos, we use raw values (from Tailwind, so both demo variants look the same).

I never worked on the doc infra and theme so I don't feel confortable approving this kind of change.
The doc looks good enough to be shipped as is imo, but I'll let the other get the final approval :pray:

Updated since we'll be working on new stuff in the near future.

> Always visible, same as the docs shell one

Updated.

> Empty state looks off here - should be centered?

I think it's fine. The items are left aligned and they're filtered as you write. If we center the empty state we change where the user needs to look. Not a strong opinion but it looks fine to me.
